items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: the only thing I know about him, he was just getting in there.

ctx.x: No, I don't know him, but his name is in the book, here. Now, we were trying to find out who started the union, 767, the musicians union in Los Angeles, the black union. Now, you mentioned -- what was his name?
Well, we've mentioned Robinson, but Robinson didn't start it.
